title: Jacob Wrestles with God
summary: God can change people and give them a new way to walk. This short lesson helps kids read, understand, and play through the passage.

read_it.prompt: Read Genesis 32:22-32 and look for how this passage teaches: God can change people and give them a new way to walk.

tell_it: Jacob wrestled through the night and received a new name, Israel. He learned that blessing comes from God.
understand_it: God can change people and give them a new way to walk. This lesson keeps the main point simple: God is faithful, His Word is true, and His people can respond with faith and obedience.
age_5_7_explanation: Jacob Wrestles with God reminds us that God is good and we can trust Him. Change matters.
age_8_11_explanation: Jacob Wrestles with God shows that following God is not only knowing the story. It means learning this truth: God can change people and give them a new way to walk.
teen_explanation: Jacob Wrestles with God gives older students room to think about faith under pressure. The passage teaches that god can change people and give them a new way to walk. It also asks how belief becomes action.
key_truths: God can change people and give them a new way to walk.
God's people can bring real needs and feelings to Him.
God is faithful and His people can trust Him.
life_application: A kid can practice this when change is needed: at school, with siblings, during disappointment, or when choosing between an easy wrong thing and a harder right thing.

quiz_questions.question: What new name was Jacob given?
quiz_questions.explanation: The passage points us back to this answer: Israel. It helps kids remember the main event and the truth it teaches.

quiz_questions.question: This lesson teaches that god can change people and give them a new way to walk.
quiz_questions.explanation: That is the plain lesson focus for this passage, stated in kid-friendly language.

memory_verse.prompt: Remember Genesis 32:28 as a short anchor for this lesson.

discussion_questions: What happened in Jacob Wrestles with God?
What does this passage teach us about God or following Him?
Where could this lesson help you at home, school, church, or with friends?

activity.title: New Name Card
activity.instructions: Draw or act out the lesson scene, then name the one clear truth: God can change people and give them a new way to walk.

prayer_prompt: Lord, help me learn from Jacob Wrestles with God. Teach me to trust You, listen to Your Word, and live this truth this week.
